name: dsh-stl-viewer
description: STL / STEP preview in the DSH side card: a hand-rolled WebGL viewer with 360° free tumbling (left-drag rotate past the poles, wheel zoom, right-drag pan) that reads STL directly and tessellates STEP, IGES and BREP through OpenCascade in a host worker, with Bambu-style measuring that snaps to vertices, edges, faces and circles, a corner panel that reads out diameters, an XYZ triad labelled with the model axes, and volume / surface / view presets / wireframe / PNG export.
author: H-h-Hh

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node test/smoke.cjs && node test/host.mjs
